replies.moment: 客户提出西联汇款至个人账户且催货，我方原话"Please send payment to my personal account, I will ship immediately"直接接受高风险付款方式，未核实身份、未问规格数量、未守公司收款底线。
replies.reply: Western Union to a personal account isn't something we can accept — payment goes to our company account only. For 10,000 pcs, what spec and destination port should I quote?
replies.reply_zh: 西联汇款到个人账户我们无法接受，款项只能走公司账户。1万件的规格和目的港是什么？我据此报价。
